svg.aria-label: Lab course — PSA from Treatment [SUBTYPE=Hormone] — Prostate, TP53 mutant, Prostate, TP53 wild-type
svg.title: Lab course — PSA from Treatment [SUBTYPE=Hormone] — Prostate, TP53 mutant, Prostate, TP53 wild-type
svg.text: Best % change after the start, worst to best
Prostate, TP53 mutant · 782 started, 641 with a baseline, 579 measured after
Prostate, TP53 wild-type · 1,899 started, 1,576 with a baseline, 1,456 measured after
PSA as % change from each patient's baseline — the mean of their readings on the last day with any, in the 90 days up to and including the first Treatment
[SUBTYPE=Hormone] — over -12 to 52 weeks around it, in 4-week bins; a patient tested several times in a bin counts once, at their mean, and no reading from the
baseline day is drawn. Median and interquartile band are read from 2-point histograms, so they are exact to within a point, and the figure draws only bins with at least 5
patients; values above +300% share the top bin. Best response is each patient's lowest value after the anchor within the window; a responder fell by at least 50%
(PCWG3's PSA50), counted exactly. Denominators: Prostate, TP53 mutant — 782 anchored, 641 with a baseline (18 of them left out: a baseline of 0 or below has no %
change), 579 with a value after; Prostate, TP53 wild-type — 1,899 anchored, 1,576 with a baseline (25 of them left out: a baseline of 0 or below has no % change), 1,456
with a value after. Patients tested more often are over-represented in any bin they appear in, and testing itself is more frequent when a value is moving; the course is of
those measured, not of everyone. Response rates compared with a two-sided Fisher test.
